description.value: Jimmy J's Grill is a community-rooted family restaurant in Chilliwack serving generous comfort-food classics and modern favourites with what it calls old-school hospitality. Located with views of Mount Cheam, it draws loyal regulars who praise large portion sizes and a varied menu. Touring cyclists passing through Chilliwack could use it as a hearty meal stop, though no cyclist-specific amenities are confirmed.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms an active family restaurant in Chilliwack, with the subpage listing the address as '8559A YOUNG RD' — slightly different from OSM's '8559 Young Road' (missing the unit suffix 'A'). The website makes no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, takeout, or any cyclist-oriented amenities, so all amenity fields default to null. No phone number appears on the website, so that field cannot be cross-confirmed.
concerns: Address discrepancy: OSM lists '8559 Young Road' but the website subpage shows '8559A YOUNG RD' — unit suffix 'A' is absent from the OSM record.
